chunks: And it has been narrated from them, peace be upon them, that they said:
When two hadiths come to you from us, then present them to the Book of Allah. So whatever agrees with the Book of Allah, take it, and whatever contradicts it, discard it.
And these reports contradict the apparent meaning of the Qur'an, so practice should be based on other than them.
And that which indicates that these reports were issued by way of taqiyyah is that...

key_terms.التَّقِيَّةِ: dissimulation employed under circumstances of precaution
key_terms.الْعَمَلُ: practical legal reliance or acting upon a report
key_terms.ظَاهِرِ الْقُرْآنِ: the apparent meaning of the Qur'an
key_terms.كِتَابِ اللَّهِ: the Qur'an as the criterion of evaluation

ai.seo_question: How should conflicting hadith from the Ahl al-Bayt be evaluated according to the Qur'an?
ai.summary: This passage sets out a principle for handling conflicting hadith: they are to be compared with the Book of Allah, and the report that agrees with it is to be accepted. It also states that certain reports are contrary to the apparent Qur'an and are therefore not to be acted upon, with the indication that they were issued under taqiyyah.
